First, note the date format given is MM-DD-YYYY: 03-19-1390.  
Subtract 268 days from 1390-03-19.  

1390 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but 1390 mod 100 = 90, not divisible by 400).  
March 19 is day 31+28+19 = 78th day of the year.  

Subtract 268 days:  
Go back into previous year: 268 - 78 = 190 days into previous year (1390 → 1389).  
1389 is not a leap year (1389 mod 4 = 1).  
Days left in 1389 after subtracting 190 days from end: 365 - 190 = 175 days from start of 1389.  
175th day of 1389: June 24 (Jan 31 + Feb 28 + Mar 31 + Apr 30 + May 31 = 151 days, plus 24 days into June = 175).  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1389-06-24
